item.title: Midwife bridges 'maternity deserts' to aid Black mothers and infants
item.description: March of Dimes research shows over half of U.S. counties lack labor and delivery hospitals. A Black midwife works to close that gap.

item.title: Alabama's second primary on Tuesday may see low voter turnout
item.description: After redrawn congressional maps in May, several districts postponed primaries to August. Voters now face confusion and potential low participation.

item.title: The hidden economic concepts in the new Planet Money board game
item.description: The game includes references to Nobel-winning research, the Laffer Curve, Scabby the Rat, Veblen's peacock, and other economic theories and jokes.

item.title: Competitive primaries in Minnesota and Wisconsin to test progressive candidates' influence
item.description: Following the Michigan primary, upcoming Midwest contests will gauge the strength of far-left candidates and their electoral impact.
